sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile), Lightning Release

system.description:
You manifest Data Release within your hands as you mold it into a more stable shape, creating a weapon that you throw at an enemy in order to pin them.

Make a ranged ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack against a creature within range, dealing 4d8 force damage and forcing them to make a Strength saving throw.

On a failure, they are knocked prone and grappled in place. A creature grappled this way remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Success: Affected creature has their speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature is knocked prone and grappled in place. A creature grappled this way remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success.

Critical Failure: Same as failure but they are Restrained for the duration.

Angel Link: You can alter the range of this jutsu to becomes 30-feet (10-foot radius), dealing damage to the original target on a hit, but forcing all creatures within 10-feet centered on the target to make the Strength saving throw vs this jutsu’s effects.

Demon Link: You can alter the range of this jutsu to become 5 feet. If you do, on a hit, if the affected creature fails their saving throw, they become Firewalled until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d8.
